campuses.title: Fremantle
campuses.text: The University's foundation campus, opened in 1992, is located in the historic West End of Fremantle, Western Australia, set within converted heritage buildings dating back to the 1880s. It hosts schools including Arts & Sciences, Business, Education, Health Sciences, Law, Medicine, Nursing & Midwifery, Philosophy & Theology and Physiotherapy.

campuses.title: Sydney
campuses.text: The Sydney campus spans two inner-city sites: Broadway in Chippendale (opened 2006), home to Arts & Sciences, Business, Education, Law and Philosophy & Theology, and Darlinghurst (opened 2008), home to Medicine and Nursing with simulated wards and consultation suites near St Vincent's Hospital.

campuses.title: Broome
campuses.text: Opened in 1994 on the site of the former Nulungu Girls College in the Kimberley region of Western Australia, the Broome campus has a special focus on training for careers in rural health and education. It is a dual-registered site also offering VET qualifications.
